name: jev-model-router
description: Sets the model of every subagent spawn (agent.spawn). The agent type sets the baseline: agents whose definition pins a model keep it, general-purpose, claude and Plan get sonnet, and TypeSafe's Jev may move those down to haiku, or up to opus when the task is risky (production, money, irreversible data). Sonnet is the ceiling otherwise; a description starting with [opus] goes to opus. No key or no verdict in time leaves the baseline, never the parent's Opus.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable when unset. Without one, spawns are routed by agent type alone.

minHaikuConfidence.title: Confidence to pick haiku
minHaikuConfidence.description: Jev's confidence that a general-purpose, claude or Plan task is mechanical, needed to run it on haiku instead of sonnet.

minRiskyForOpus.title: Risk that lifts a spawn to opus
minRiskyForOpus.description: Jev's probability that doing the task wrong is costly or irreversible, at or above which a judged spawn runs on opus.

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before routing by agent type alone.

maxBriefChars.title: Brief length sent to Jev
maxBriefChars.description: The subagent prompt is cut to this many characters before it leaves the machine.

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the session log.
